items.title: Updated: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: What makes Amazon’s new sustainability tech accelerator unique
items.summary: Three-quarters of large companies support startup investments that further their strategic goals.

items.title: Who Gives A Crap, ProCook and Grind have ads banned for misleading carbon-neutral delivery claims
items.summary: The regulator said consumers could not tell whether the claims were based on reducing emissions at source or offsetting them through carbon credits.

items.title: ‘Hypocrisy’: Banks pumped $220bn into plastic polluters despite climate goals
items.summary: Between 2019 and 2025, leading financial institutions provided $219bn in credit to four of the world's biggest plastic consumers, a new report has revealed.

items.title: WEBINAR NEXT WEEK: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: COP31 Covered podcast: ‘Electric or shock’ – COP31’s big electrification push
items.summary: The second episode of edie’s daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with Isabel Beltran of the Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet.

items.title: From Brazil’s fossil fuel phase-out roadmap to adaptation finance framework: What happened on 10 November at COP31?
items.summary: One question ran through discussions on the second day of COP31 in Antalya: what is the point of electrification if the electricity is not clean?

items.title: Testing times: The six-week gap in Europe’s packaging rules
items.summary: Digital technology can prepare packaging compliance documents in minutes. So why does obtaining the evidence behind them still take weeks?

items.title: Preparing your business for the future cost of EV charging
items.summary: Last year, 70% of the world's leading corporate fleets did not add a single new petrol or diesel vehicle, according to the Climate Group.

items.title: COP31: Businesses and banks back Global Electrification Pledge to usher in ‘age of electricity’
items.summary: The COP31 Presidency’s landmark pledge to usher in the “age of electricity” by increasing the share of final energy demand met by electricity has been backed by more than 180 companies and financial institutions, while utility organisations have committed more than $150bn annually to the scheme.
